title: EMA ABEL limits, CVwR 40%, comfortably inside the cap

oracle.method_note: DETERMINISTIC. scABEL is a closed-form function of CV and simulates nothing, so this is the only scaled-procedure comparison in the harness where agreement is exact rather than statistical. Note that scABEL computes the lower limit as 1/upper (R/scABEL.R line 119) where EMA states the pair symmetrically as exp[+/- k.sWR]; equal in exact arithmetic.

comparisons.tolerance_basis: EXACT to floating point, because NOTHING IS SIMULATED ON EITHER SIDE. PowerTOST's scABEL is a closed-form function of CV (R/scABEL.R) and be_stats.ema_hvd.ema_abel_limits is the same closed form. Both evaluate exp(+/- 0.760 * sqrt(log(1 + CV^2))) from the same exact inputs, so the only permissible difference is accumulated rounding in log, sqrt and exp - a few units in the last place of a number near 100, which 1e-9 bounds generously. A larger difference would mean a different regulatory constant or a different scale, which is a substantive disagreement and not rounding. This is NOT a Monte Carlo tolerance and must never be widened into one.

EXACTLY equal, no tolerance at all. Both sides carry EMA's regulatory constant as the literal 0.760 the guideline states - be-stats in EMA_HVD_CONSTANTS, PowerTOST in reg_const("EMA") as r_const=0.76. These are the same decimal and must compare identical; any difference means one side is deriving a constant the regulator stated.

not_cross_checkable: The overall EMA decision. scABEL returns the acceptance limits, not a verdict, and PowerTOST exposes no dataset-level entry point that would produce one. The decision is covered instead by tier 1B - EMA's own Data set I and Data set II, with the point estimates and 90% intervals the regulator published, reproduced in tests/validation/test_ema_tier1b.py.

Method A itself. PowerTOST simulates studies; it does not fit an ANOVA to a supplied dataset and return a contrast. Again tier 1B covers it, and covers it better: a regulator's published result beats an independent implementation's agreement.

p(BE-ABEL) from power.scABEL. Two reasons, both established from the source before any fixture was written (VAL-EMA-ABEL-001): it is the MIXED decision rather than the ABEL criterion, and for EMA it routes to power.scABEL1, which documents four 'purely empirical' adaptations. A tuned approximation cannot serve as an oracle.
notes: Widening doing ordinary work: the limits are materially wider than 80-125 and nowhere near the cap. If the regulatory constant or the CV-to-sWR conversion were wrong, this case would show it first.
